response.original_title: Siouxsie and the Banshees: Twice Upon A Time
response.overview: Twice Upon a Time: The Singles is a 1992 video compilation (following up on their 1981 video/audio compilation, Once Upon a Time) by Siouxsie And The Banshees – Twice Upon A Time - Discogs released on VHS (and accompanying the companion CD/vinyl audio release). The collection covers singles released from 1982 through 1992, showcasing the band's evolution from post-punk and goth-rock pioneers into more expansive, cinematic pop and alternative styles.
